description: This Java class 'MainActivity' defined in an Android wear OS application, manages communication with a paired wearable device via GoogleApiClient and Wearable MessageApi. It handles lifecycle events, sends messages, and displays toast notifications upon receiving specific messages.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages communication with a wearable device, handling messages and user interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, and builds GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Connects GoogleApiClient if not already connected.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Adds message listener when GoogleApiClient is connected.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Removes message listener when connection is suspended.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages and shows appropriate toasts.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Logs an error if GoogleApiClient connection fails.

methods.name: onStartWearableActivityClick
methods.description: Sends a message to connected wearables to start an activity when a button is clicked.

methods.name: getSendMessageResultCallback
methods.description: Provides callback to log failure of message sending.
